title: Polarization–Dark Channel Fusion Image Dehazing Algorithm Based on Bayesian Automatic Optimization
content: To address the limitations of traditional dark channel prior (DCP)-based dehazing algorithms, such as fixed parameters, insufficient utilization of polarization information, poor adaptability to complex haze conditions, and low accuracy in transmission estimation, this paper proposes an adaptive polarization image dehazing algorithm that integrates physical priors with Bayesian optimization. First, the degree of linear polarization (DOLP) is calculated from multiangle polarization images, and Gaussian smoothing and percentile normalization are employed to improve the stability of the polarization features. Second, a joint mask combining dark channel candidate regions and high-polarization regions is constructed to achieve accurate atmospheric light selection and color balance correction, thereby alleviating color distortion caused by inaccurate atmospheric light estimation in conventional methods. An adaptive parameter initialization strategy based on physical priors is subsequently proposed by combining the haze concentration statistics with the polarization signal intensity. This strategy dynamically initializes the dehazing weight, minimum transmission, polarization modulation coefficient, and gamma correction coefficient, providing reasonable starting values for the optimization process. Finally, using the no-reference image quality assessment metric natural image quality evaluator (NIQE) as the objective function, Bayesian optimization is adopted to globally refine the key parameters, thus achieving a balance between physical interpretability and scene adaptability. The experimental results demonstrate that, compared with the conventional DCP algorithm and fixed-parameter polarization dehazing methods, the proposed algorithm effectively optimizes the NIQE score of images and significantly improves dehazing completeness, color fidelity, and detail preservation. The proposed method can adapt to haze scenes with different concentrations.
